previous_statement: Definitional amplification bridge (no new algebraic hypothesis): the amplified column sesquilinear form occurring in the H-CB datum and denoted by <.,.> on M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} is the canonical direct-sum amplification of the level-one form. Thus, writing Y=(Y_i) and V=(V_i), its defining coordinate formula is <Y,V>_n := sum_{i=1}^n <Y_i,V_i>. The subscript is suppressed in the contract. A form c*sum_i<Y_i,V_i> with c != 1 is a different sesquilinear form, not the amplified form denoted in this theorem.
new_statement: Dependency audit (corrected claim): the allowed inputs determine the level-one form but do not determine the normalization of the amplified column sesquilinear form. Therefore the formula <Y,V>_n=sum_i<Y_i,V_i> is not derivable from the currently registered definitions. An explicit allowed definition or dependency giving this coordinate-sum normalization is necessary before this node can support 1.3.2.
